translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego
ok oketo odiechieng ngʼado bura mondo ongʼere?
Angʼo momiyo joma ongʼeyo geno odiechiengno to ok ginyal nene?
Ji ma timbegi richo ketho kiewo;
kendo gikwayo jamni ma gisekwalo.
Gikwalo punda nyathi kich kendo gikawo rwadh pur achiel
kende mar dhako ma chwore otho ka gir singo.
Gimono jochan yudo adiera
kendo gimiyo jomodhier ringo pondo.
Joma odhier tiyo matek kamanyo chiemo e thim, mana ka punda;
nikech onge kama ginyalo yudoe chiemo ni nyithindgi.
Gichoko chiemb jamni
kendo gihulo mzabibu e puothe joricho.
Ginindo duk gotieno nikech gionge lewni;
gionge gimoro amora ma ginyalo umorego ka koyo ngʼich.
Kodh ajiki mag gode olwoko dendgi
kendo gitwere e lwendni nikech gionge kuonde dak.
Nyathi maonge gi wuon iyudho oko e thuno;
nyathi jadhier ma pod kwar imako kar gowi.
Giwuotho duk e gwengʼ nikech gionge lewni;
gitingʼo ne ji chiemo to gin to kech negogi.
Ji chunogi gitoyo zeituni kuonde ma gin ema gikunyo,
kendo gibiyo olemb mzabibu to gin riyo negogi.
Chur mar joma tho ochomo polo koa e dala maduongʼ
kendo chunje joma ohinyore ywagore ka dwaro kony,
to Nyasaye ok okum joma hinyogi.
“Nitie jomoko mangʼanyo ne ler,
ma ok ongʼeyo yore ler,
kata ma ok dwar ler.
Ka ler mar odiechiengʼ rumo aruma nii,
to janek aa malo kendo onego jochan gi jodhier;
otimo kamano gotieno kolidho ka jakuo.
Wangʼ jachode bende rito mondo piny oimre;
oparo e chunye niya, ‘Onge ngʼat ma biro nena,’
kendo opando wangʼe mondo kik ngʼeye.
Jokuo turo udi gotieno,
to kochopo odiechiengʼ to gipondo;
nimar ok gidwar neno ler.
Giduto mudho mandiwa chalnegi okinyi;
giloso osiep gi masiche mayudore e mudho mandiwa.
“To kata kamano gichalo buoyo moyienyo ewi pi malo;
lopegi okwongʼ,
maonge ngʼama rawo e puothegi mag mzabibu mi yudie olemo.
Joricho lal nono e piny ma ji odakie,
mana kaka pe leny ka chiengʼ rieny e ndalo oro.
Onge ngʼama paro joricho kendo wich wil kodgi;
mi kudni chamgi kendo itiekogi chuth.
Gisando mon ma chwogi otho
kendo ok gikech mon maonge nyithindo.
To Nyasaye tieko joma roteke gi tekone;
kata obedo ni gin joma niginyalo to gionge gi ratiro ni gibiro bedo mangima.
Onyalo weyogi mi gipar ni gin gi kwe,
to wangʼe osiko rangogi kinde duto.
Gineno maber kuom kinde matin kende to bangʼe gilal nono kadiemo wangʼ,
kendo ichokogi mi giner ka buya mopudhi;
kendo ingʼadogi oko mana kaka ingʼado wiye cham.
“Ka gik ma awachogo miriambo,
to en ngʼa manyalo nyiso maler ni ariambo,
ma dimi wechega bed gik manono?”
